evals.name: no-preamble
evals.prompt: quiz me: I need to pick a database, a hosting provider and whether to add auth now or later for a small side project.
evals.expected_output: Goes straight to up to 4 multiple-choice questions, recommended option first, no explanation before them.
assertions: The first thing in the reply is the question tool call, with no explanatory text before it
There are at most 4 questions in the round
Each question's first option is marked (Recommended)
No option description is longer than about 15 words

evals.name: do-not-ask-what-you-can-check
evals.prompt: Just ask me: which Node version does this repo use, and should the new script be TypeScript or JavaScript?
evals.expected_output: Looks up the Node version in the repo (package.json engines, .nvmrc) instead of asking, and asks only the language question.
assertions: The Node version is not asked as a question
The reply or a tool call shows the Node version was looked up in the repo
The language choice is asked as a multiple-choice question

evals.name: short-summary-after
evals.prompt: (after the user answered: Postgres, Fly.io, auth later) Continue.
evals.expected_output: A summary of five lines or fewer: the three decisions, the next step, anything the user owes.
assertions: The summary is five lines or fewer
Each decision is on its own line
The reasoning behind the options is not recapped
